name: teralynk-monorepo
description: Teralynk — application desktop premium distribuée via GitHub, et son panel d'administration indépendant.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @teralynk/app && npm run build -w @teralynk/admin
scripts.dist:app: npm run build -w @teralynk/app && npm run dist -w @teralynk/app
scripts.dist:admin: npm run build -w @teralynk/admin && npm run dist -w @teralynk/admin
